seoTitle: Word Cloud Generator from Text or Counts (SVG)
metaDescription: Paste text or word counts to get a packed word cloud as SVG, with stop words skipped. Same seed, same layout. Free and private.
intro: Counts words in your text, or reads word and count lines, and packs them into a cloud where size follows frequency.
why:
Word clouds are blunt but quick for a look at a survey, a speech or a set of keywords. Paste raw text or your own counts; common English words are skipped for raw text so the interesting words stand out.

Layout is a spiral placement with rectangles, so words never overlap; those that do not fit are reported rather than shrunk silently. A table lists the counts, since size is a poor way to read exact values.
howTo: Paste text, or lines like word 12.
Set the maximum words and tick rotation if you like.
Change the seed for another layout.

faq.q: How does it know my input is counts?
faq.a: If most lines end in a number it reads them as word and count.
Words are split on letters and digits of any script; the stop-word list is English only.
